overview: پس از هشت ماه اقامت در بیمارستان روانی، مردی دچار رنج، به خانه بازمی‌گردد تا با خواهرش زندگی کند؛ اما یک مستأجر مرموز ممکن است سعی در کشتن او داشته باشد.
overview_en: Allan (Anthony Perkins) is blamed for an accidental fire that killed his father (Kent Smith), disfigured his sister (Julie Harris) and landed him in an institution. Eight months later, partially blind and guilt-stricken, he's let out of an institution and rents a room from his estranged sibling in an effort to put his life back together, but someone is out for revenge and wants to drive him crazy.
